env-card-content.report: 0.7 put env-card-content on a card without actions and on an action card's body, and 1.0 has no class for either: style .env-card:not([data-actions]) for the card, or .env-card-body for the body of a card with actions.

env-feature-card.report: FeatureCard is the feature cards pattern in 1.0, a Card holding a Row of Text and a Button: style env-card, env-text and env-button, or classes of your own on them.

env-card-layout.report: Card's feature layout is the feature cards pattern in 1.0, a Card holding a Row of Text and a Button: style a class of your own on the row.

env-card-icon.report: Card's feature layout is the feature cards pattern in 1.0, where the icon sits in muted Text: style a class of your own on it.

env-card.report: A card carries no data-layout in 1.0: a card with actions is .env-card[data-actions], and the feature layout is the feature cards pattern.
